collection.name: Academic Writing 100
collection.description: 100 words for precise academic writing: reporting verbs, cause/effect and comparison language, nominalizations, formal connectors, and hedging.

meta.note: Claude-authored (no external LLM). Fields map to lib/types.ts EnrichableFields; ipa intentionally left blank per captain. Packs are strictly disjoint (no word appears in more than one collection). 'category' is metadata for review/tagging.

words.definition_en: to present reasons for a position or interpretation
words.example_simple: The author argues that reform is needed.
words.example_complex: Several economists argue that austerity measures deepened, rather than resolved, the recession.
words.false_friend_note: In academic English 'argue' means to reason a case, not to quarrel.

words.definition_en: to state firmly that something is true
words.example_simple: She asserts that the theory is flawed.
words.example_complex: The paper asserts that early intervention yields the greatest long-term benefit.

words.definition_en: to argue a point, often against an opposing view
words.example_simple: Critics contend that the data is unreliable.
words.example_complex: Proponents contend that renewable subsidies accelerate innovation, a claim the evidence broadly supports.

words.vi_meaning: khẳng định, tuyên bố (chưa chứng minh)
words.definition_en: to state something as true without full proof
words.example_simple: The report claims a strong link.
words.example_complex: The authors claim a causal relationship, though their design only establishes correlation.

words.vi_meaning: đưa ra giả định, nêu ra (làm cơ sở lập luận)
words.definition_en: to put forward an idea as a basis for argument
words.example_complex: The framework posits that behaviour is shaped as much by context as by individual choice.

words.vi_meaning: đề xuất, đưa ra (ý tưởng/giả thuyết)
words.definition_en: to suggest an idea or explanation for consideration
words.example_complex: The researchers propose an alternative explanation that accounts for the anomalies in earlier studies.

words.definition_en: to indicate something as likely without asserting it firmly
words.example_complex: The findings suggest, though do not prove, that sleep quality mediates the effect.

words.definition_en: to show clearly with evidence
words.example_complex: The trial demonstrates a measurable improvement in outcomes among the treated group.

words.vi_meaning: minh họa, làm rõ bằng ví dụ
words.definition_en: to make something clear by using examples
words.example_complex: This case study illustrates how policy and practice can diverge in unexpected ways.

words.definition_en: to point to or be a sign of something
words.example_complex: Preliminary results indicate a trend that warrants further, larger-scale investigation.

words.definition_en: to suggest something indirectly rather than state it
words.example_complex: Such a correlation implies, but cannot confirm, an underlying causal mechanism.
words.false_friend_note: 'Imply' is what a speaker/text does; 'infer' is what a reader does — do not confuse them.

words.definition_en: to draw attention to something significant
words.example_simple: The report highlights a key issue.
words.example_complex: The review highlights a persistent gap between theoretical models and empirical evidence.

words.definition_en: to give particular importance to something
words.example_complex: The paper emphasises that correlation, however strong, does not establish causation.

words.definition_en: to accept that something is true or valid
words.example_complex: The study acknowledges its small sample size as a constraint on generalisability.

words.vi_meaning: lưu ý, chỉ ra (một cách trung tính)
words.definition_en: to mention or remark on something
words.example_complex: It should be noted that these conclusions rest on data from a single region.

words.definition_en: to notice or comment on something, or to watch systematically
words.example_complex: The authors observe that the effect diminishes markedly once socioeconomic status is controlled for.

words.vi_meaning: khăng khăng cho rằng, giữ quan điểm
words.definition_en: to state an opinion firmly and continue to hold it
words.example_simple: He maintains that the model holds.
words.example_complex: Despite the counter-evidence, the original authors maintain that their interpretation is sound.

words.definition_en: to make something previously unknown become clear
words.example_complex: Closer analysis reveals that the apparent improvement was largely driven by two outlying cases.

words.vi_meaning: xác lập, chứng minh chắc chắn
words.definition_en: to prove or firmly set up something as true
words.example_simple: The study establishes a clear trend.
words.example_complex: While the correlation is well established, the direction of causation remains contested.

words.definition_en: to investigate or inspect something in detail
words.example_complex: This paper examines whether class size has any measurable effect on academic attainment.

words.definition_en: to study something systematically to find out the facts
words.example_complex: The research investigates the extent to which urban design influences residents' physical activity.

words.definition_en: to examine or consider something in order to learn more
words.example_simple: The essay explores the theme of loss.
words.example_complex: This section explores how digital platforms reshape the way citizens engage with politics.

words.definition_en: to judge the value or quality of something
words.example_complex: The paper evaluates the effectiveness of the policy against its stated objectives.

words.definition_en: to estimate or judge the nature or extent of something
words.example_complex: It remains difficult to assess the long-term impact given the limited follow-up period.

words.definition_en: to draw attention to a fact
words.example_complex: Critics point out that the sample excluded precisely the groups most affected by the policy.

words.definition_en: to reach a decision or judgement after reasoning
words.example_simple: The report concludes with a warning.
words.example_complex: The authors conclude that policy, rather than technology, is the principal barrier to adoption.

words.definition_en: as a result; in this way (formal)
words.example_simple: The samples differ; thus comparison is limited.
words.example_complex: The instrument was recalibrated between trials, thus introducing a potential source of error.

words.definition_en: for this reason (formal)
words.example_simple: Resources are scarce; hence the trade-offs.
words.example_complex: The metric conflates two distinct phenomena; hence its predictive value is limited.

words.definition_en: by that means; with the result that
words.example_simple: It cuts costs, thereby raising profit.
words.example_complex: Automation standardises the process, thereby reducing variation between operators.
words.false_friend_note: Followed by an -ing clause, not a full sentence.

words.definition_en: to cause a particular result
words.example_complex: Prolonged exposure to pollutants can lead to a measurable decline in respiratory function.

words.definition_en: to cause something to happen as an outcome
words.example_complex: The intervention resulted in a modest but statistically significant reduction in relapse rates.
words.false_friend_note: 'Result in' takes an effect; 'result from' takes a cause.

words.definition_en: to cause something to begin or exist
words.example_simple: The policy gave rise to protests.
words.example_complex: Rapid technological change has given rise to new ethical questions that regulation has yet to address.

words.vi_meaning: bắt nguồn từ, xuất phát từ
words.definition_en: to originate or develop as a result of something
words.example_simple: The error stems from bad data.
words.example_complex: Much of the disagreement stems from differing definitions of the key terms.

words.definition_en: to regard something as caused by a particular thing
words.example_simple: They attribute the rise to demand.
words.example_complex: The authors attribute the discrepancy to differences in measurement rather than to any real effect.

words.definition_en: because of (formal)
words.example_simple: The delay was owing to weather.
words.example_complex: Owing to incomplete records, the earliest period could not be reliably reconstructed.

words.definition_en: caused by; because of
words.example_simple: The gap is due to funding.
words.example_complex: The observed decline is due, at least in part, to changes in how the data were collected.

words.definition_en: to be one of several causes of something
words.example_complex: Several factors, including poor infrastructure, contribute to the region's persistent inequality.

words.definition_en: to cause something, especially change, to happen
words.example_simple: The law brought about real change.
words.example_complex: The digital revolution brought about a fundamental shift in how information is produced and shared.

words.definition_en: in a like manner; used to draw a parallel
words.example_simple: Similarly, sales fell in the north.
words.example_complex: Urban centres saw sharp growth; similarly, but to a lesser degree, mid-sized towns expanded.

words.definition_en: in the same way; also
words.example_complex: The control group showed no change; likewise, the placebo condition remained stable throughout.

words.definition_en: introducing an opposite situation
words.example_complex: High earners benefited from the reform; conversely, those on low incomes saw their position worsen.

words.definition_en: despite; in spite of (formal)
words.example_complex: Notwithstanding its methodological limitations, the study offers valuable preliminary insight.

words.definition_en: although; even if (formal)
words.example_complex: The intervention produced gains, albeit smaller than the authors had anticipated.
words.false_friend_note: Usually followed by an adjective or phrase, not a full clause.

words.definition_en: to be unlike something else
words.example_simple: These results differ from earlier ones.
words.example_complex: The present findings differ substantially from those reported in comparable settings a decade ago.

words.definition_en: to match or be equivalent to something
words.example_complex: The observed values correspond closely to those predicted by the theoretical model.

words.vi_meaning: so với đó, xét về mặt so sánh
words.definition_en: when compared with something else
words.example_simple: The second figure is tiny by comparison.
words.example_complex: By comparison with its neighbours, the country invests remarkably little in higher education.

words.definition_en: the act of putting a plan or policy into effect
words.example_complex: The gap between design and implementation often determines whether a policy succeeds.

words.vi_meaning: sự tiếp thu, thu nhận (kiến thức/tài sản)
words.definition_en: the process of gaining a skill, knowledge, or asset
words.example_complex: Second-language acquisition proceeds most rapidly when learners receive comprehensible input.

words.definition_en: an evaluation or judgement of something
words.example_complex: A rigorous assessment of the programme requires comparing it against a suitable control group.

words.definition_en: a clear difference between two things
words.example_complex: It is essential to draw a distinction between correlation and causation when interpreting the data.

words.definition_en: the process of coming into existence or prominence
words.example_simple: The emergence of the internet changed everything.
words.example_complex: The emergence of social media as a news source has transformed public debate.

words.definition_en: a mutual relationship or connection between variables
words.example_simple: There's a correlation between the two.
words.example_complex: A strong correlation between income and health does not, by itself, establish a causal pathway.
words.false_friend_note: Correlation is not causation — a standard caution in academic writing.

words.definition_en: a likely consequence or suggested meaning
words.example_complex: The implications of these results extend well beyond the specific context of the study.

words.definition_en: an inclination to behave or develop in a particular way
words.example_simple: There is a tendency to overspend.
words.example_complex: The data reveal a marked tendency for participants to underestimate long-term risks.

words.vi_meaning: mức độ phổ biến, tỷ lệ hiện mắc
words.definition_en: the extent to which something is widespread
words.example_simple: The prevalence of the disease rose.
words.example_complex: The rising prevalence of anxiety among adolescents has prompted calls for earlier intervention.

words.definition_en: the great size or extent of something
words.example_simple: The magnitude of the problem is huge.
words.example_complex: Although the effect is statistically significant, its magnitude is too small to be practically meaningful.

words.vi_meaning: sự chênh lệch, khác biệt (không khớp)
words.definition_en: a lack of agreement or consistency between things
words.example_simple: There's a discrepancy in the figures.
words.example_complex: The discrepancy between self-reported and measured behaviour raises questions about the survey's validity.

words.definition_en: a basic structure of ideas used to analyse something
words.example_complex: The study adopts a theoretical framework that integrates economic and psychological perspectives.

words.definition_en: a fact or situation that is observed to exist or happen
words.example_complex: Urban heat islands are a well-documented phenomenon with clear implications for city planning.

words.definition_en: a proposed explanation to be tested
words.example_complex: The results are consistent with the hypothesis that stress impairs memory consolidation.

words.definition_en: a typical model or pattern of thought in a field
words.example_complex: The discovery prompted a paradigm shift in how the discipline understands memory.

words.definition_en: despite what has just been said
words.example_simple: It is imperfect but useful nonetheless.
words.example_complex: The theory has well-known limitations; it remains, nonetheless, the most widely applied in the field.

words.definition_en: in a way appropriate to what has happened; therefore
words.example_simple: The rules changed, and we acted accordingly.
words.example_complex: Demand proved higher than forecast, and production was scaled up accordingly.

words.definition_en: afterwards; following in time or order
words.example_complex: The initial findings were subsequently replicated in three independent laboratories.

words.vi_meaning: cho đến nay, từ trước tới giờ
words.definition_en: until now; up to this point (formal)
words.example_simple: This was a hitherto unknown effect.
words.example_complex: The technique reveals structures that were hitherto invisible to conventional imaging.

words.vi_meaning: đáng chú ý là, đặc biệt
words.definition_en: in particular; used to single out something important
words.example_complex: Several variables, most notably parental education, accounted for much of the variance.

words.vi_meaning: cụ thể là, đặc biệt là
words.definition_en: used to specify one thing among several
words.example_simple: One factor in particular stands out.
words.example_complex: In particular, the youngest cohort responded quite differently from the rest of the sample.

words.definition_en: used to say something is likely though not certain
words.example_simple: The gap is presumably due to cost.
words.example_complex: The participants who dropped out did so, presumably, because the task was too demanding.

words.vi_meaning: bề ngoài là, có vẻ như (nhưng chưa chắc)
words.definition_en: apparently, but perhaps not really so
words.example_complex: The policy, ostensibly aimed at fairness, in practice benefited the already advantaged.

words.definition_en: to seem to be the case without certainty
words.example_simple: The two appear to be linked.
words.example_complex: The variables appear to interact, though a larger sample is needed to confirm this.

words.definition_en: a cautious way to state a probable claim
words.example_simple: It is likely that costs will rise.
words.example_complex: It is likely that multiple mechanisms, rather than a single cause, underlie the observed effect.

words.definition_en: in general terms, without going into detail
words.example_complex: Broadly speaking, the literature supports the hypothesis, though important exceptions remain.

words.vi_meaning: trong chừng mực mà, ở mức độ mà
words.definition_en: to the extent that
words.example_simple: It helps, insofar as it saves time.
words.example_complex: The theory is useful insofar as it generates testable predictions, but it explains little of the mechanism.

words.definition_en: appearing to be the case
words.example_simple: The two seemingly unrelated facts are linked.
words.example_complex: The seemingly contradictory results can be reconciled once the different timescales are taken into account.

words.definition_en: large in amount, value, or importance
words.example_complex: The reform required substantial investment before any benefits became apparent.

words.definition_en: widespread; common in a particular place or time
words.example_simple: The habit is prevalent among teens.
words.example_complex: The belief remains prevalent despite decades of evidence to the contrary.

words.vi_meaning: vững chắc, đáng tin cậy (kết quả/phương pháp)
words.definition_en: strong and reliable, holding up under scrutiny
words.example_complex: The effect proved robust across different model specifications and control variables.

words.definition_en: including all or nearly all elements
words.example_complex: A comprehensive analysis would need to incorporate data that were unavailable at the time.
words.false_friend_note: 'Comprehensive' means thorough; 'comprehensible' means understandable — do not confuse them.

words.vi_meaning: nằm bên dưới, cơ bản (ẩn sau)
words.definition_en: forming the hidden basis or cause of something
words.example_complex: Treating symptoms without addressing the underlying cause rarely produces lasting change.

words.definition_en: belonging separately to each of the people or things mentioned
words.example_simple: They returned to their respective homes.
words.example_complex: The two groups improved by 12% and 8% respectively over the study period.

words.vi_meaning: khả thi, có thể thực hiện
words.definition_en: possible and practical to do
words.example_complex: While technically feasible, the approach is unlikely to be economically feasible at scale.

words.definition_en: so small as to be not worth considering
words.example_complex: The additional cost is negligible relative to the substantial gains in reliability.

words.definition_en: concerning; in relation to (formal)
collocations: with regard to the first point
words.example_simple: With regard to cost, it is efficient.
words.example_complex: With regard to reliability, the newer instrument clearly outperforms its predecessor.
words.false_friend_note: Note 'regard' (singular); 'with regards to' is a common error.

words.definition_en: with respect to a particular aspect
words.example_simple: It's better in terms of speed.
words.example_complex: In terms of long-term outcomes, the two approaches proved almost indistinguishable.

words.vi_meaning: cấu thành, tạo nên; được coi là
words.definition_en: to be or be equivalent to something; to form a whole
words.example_complex: Repeated exposure of this kind may constitute a significant risk to public health.

words.definition_en: to justify or require a particular action
words.example_complex: The magnitude of the discrepancy warrants a closer examination of the measurement procedure.

words.vi_meaning: làm nền tảng, củng cố cho
words.definition_en: to support or form the basis of an argument or system
words.example_complex: The assumptions that underpin the model rarely hold in real-world conditions.

words.vi_meaning: chứng thực, củng cố (bằng bằng chứng)
words.definition_en: to confirm or support a finding with additional evidence
words.example_complex: The interview data corroborate the survey findings, lending greater confidence to the overall conclusion.

words.definition_en: to prove that a statement or theory is wrong
words.example_simple: The study refutes the earlier claim.
words.example_complex: The new data refute the long-standing assumption that the two variables are unrelated.

words.definition_en: to provide evidence to support a claim
words.example_simple: There is little evidence to substantiate the theory.
words.example_complex: The authors substantiate their argument with data drawn from three independent sources.

words.vi_meaning: đưa ra giả định (làm tiền đề)
words.definition_en: to suggest or assume something as a basis for reasoning
words.example_simple: The model postulates two hidden factors.
words.example_complex: Early theorists postulated an underlying force that later experiments were unable to detect.

words.definition_en: to describe or define something precisely
words.example_complex: The introduction carefully delineates the scope of the study and the questions it does not address.

words.definition_en: to explain the cause of something, or to make up a proportion
words.example_simple: Genetics may account for the difference.
words.example_complex: Together, these three factors account for nearly two-thirds of the observed variation.

words.definition_en: in contrast with; rather than
words.example_simple: We measured accuracy, as opposed to speed.
words.example_complex: The study focuses on long-term outcomes, as opposed to the short-term gains emphasised elsewhere.

words.definition_en: a standard used to judge or decide something
words.example_simple: Cost is not the only criterion.
words.example_complex: Studies were included only if they met a strict methodological criterion.

words.definition_en: the system of methods used in a study
words.example_complex: Doubts about the methodology cast some uncertainty on the reliability of the results.

words.vi_meaning: tiền đề, luận điểm cơ sở
words.definition_en: a statement assumed to be true as the basis of an argument
words.example_simple: The argument rests on a flawed premise.
words.example_complex: If the central premise is mistaken, the conclusions that follow cannot be trusted.

words.vi_meaning: thực nghiệm, dựa trên thực chứng
words.definition_en: based on observation or experiment rather than theory
words.example_simple: There is little empirical evidence for this.
words.example_complex: The claim is intuitively appealing but has scant empirical support.

words.vi_meaning: nổi bật, đáng chú ý nhất
words.definition_en: most noticeable or important
words.example_simple: The most salient point is cost.
words.example_complex: The most salient finding is that the effect disappears entirely among older participants.

words.vi_meaning: thích đáng, liên quan trực tiếp
words.definition_en: relevant and applicable to the matter at hand
words.example_complex: The review omits several studies that are highly pertinent to the central argument.
